output.summary: The win-rate collapse is mainly a measurement and mix artifact. On 2026-04-15 the MQL threshold fell from 60 to 40, and phone contacts began creating opportunities automatically. The 60-day auto-close then marked many of them Closed-Lost. The 40-59 band (750 closed, 3.3% won) drags the blended rate to 18%. Excluding that band, the Q3 rate is 29.4%, against 31% in Q1. Non-marketing win rate is flat. Activity per rep is up, comp pay is flat, and Brannock's price cut shows no effect. An accountability program would punish the wrong party. Re-baseline the reporting and stop auto-creating field opportunities for 40-59 leads. Vendor quality (H4) and slow response on high-score leads remain unconfirmed. Terminating LeadSpring is premature.
